description: This file defines the 'Create' feature for user registration in the application. It includes data models, a request command, validation logic, and a handler to process user creation, including validation, password hashing, and token generation.

classes.name: Create.UserData
classes.description: Data transfer object representing user input data with optional username, email, and password.

classes.name: Create.Command
classes.description: Request command encapsulating user data, implementing IRequest for MediatR.

classes.name: Create.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validation class ensuring non-null and non-empty username, email, and password.

classes.name: Create.Handler
classes.description: Handles the user creation process: validation, checking for existing username/email, password hashing, database insertion, and token generation.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Main logic for processing user creation, including validation checks, password hashing, saving to database, and returning user envelope.
